title: TutorialSpec
$comment: v1.0. Output of packages/tutorial-compiler (Workflow -> TutorialSpec), consumed by the player (Phase 2) and the Remotion export (Phase 5). Design: docs/research/phase-2-together-tutorial-spec-design.md.
description: An interactive tutorial compiled from one Verified Workflow. Times are integer milliseconds; geometry is CSS pixels in page coordinates. Frames are derived only at video export: frame = round(ms / 1000 * fps).

viewport.description: The recording's viewport: the coordinate space of every bbox and point.

fps.description: Frame rate for the video export only. The player ignores it.

total_duration_ms.description: End of the last scene (start_ms + duration_ms).

scenes.description: One scene per workflow step, in step order.

Scene.title: Scene
Scene.description: One workflow step. start_ms is on the tutorial timeline; every other time inside a scene (cursor, caption words) is relative to the scene's start.

step_seq.description: seq of the workflow step this scene shows.

title.description: Short label for the step list.

start_ms.description: Scene start on the tutorial timeline.

action.description: What the step does. value is copied from the workflow and is already masked if the step is sensitive.

sensitive.description: The step typed a secret: show no typed text, only that something was entered.

scroll.description: Window scroll during the action, from the step. The highlight's viewport box is highlight.bbox - scroll.

camera.description: Zoom and pan. Null: show the whole viewport.

cursor.description: Null for steps without an element (navigate, a key press without target, wait).

highlight.description: Null for steps without an element.

text.description: The step's instruction text, shown and narrated.

words.description: Word timings relative to the scene start, when known at compile time (Piper, Phase 5). Null when they only exist at playback (Web Speech boundary events).

RecordingSlice.title: RecordingSlice
RecordingSlice.description: The part of the workflow's rrweb recording this scene replays.

start_ms.description: Milliseconds since the recording's first event.

end_ms.description: Milliseconds since the recording's first event.

baseline_snapshot_index.description: Index (in the recording's event list) of the FullSnapshot to start from, so the slice renders on its own.

Point.title: Point
Point.description: A point in CSS pixels, page coordinates.

easing.description: CSS easing function for the pan/zoom.

Cursor.title: Cursor
Cursor.description: A cubic Bezier glide from path[0] to path[3]; times relative to the scene start.
